id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Multi-drop CAN bus shared by all nodes. A CANopen network has one NMT master and up to 127 NMT slaves, each with a Node-ID (1..127). Communication objects are distributed by COB-ID using the producer/consumer (PDO/SYNC/EMCY), client/server (SDO), and master/slave (NMT) models.

supported_topologies.name: CAN multi-drop bus
supported_topologies.description: All nodes share the CAN bus; bus access is by CAN arbitration on the COB-ID.

supported_topologies.name: Producer/consumer (PDO)
supported_topologies.description: One producer broadcasts a PDO; any number of consumers receive it.

supported_topologies.name: Client/server (SDO)
supported_topologies.description: An SDO client accesses the object dictionary of an SDO server.

supported_topologies.name: Master/slave (NMT)
supported_topologies.description: One NMT master controls the NMT state of all slaves.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Controls the NMT state machine of every slave (start / stop / reset) and may manage configuration.
A CANopen device that implements the OD and the NMT slave state machine; up to 127 per network.
Reads/writes OD entries of a server (often the master or a config tool).
Exposes its object dictionary for client access.
Produces (TPDO) or consumes (RPDO) real-time process data.

fields.interconnect_role: CANopen distributes data over a shared CAN bus by COB-ID. Real-time process data uses producer/consumer PDOs (broadcast, low overhead); configuration uses client/server SDOs (confirmed, addressed by index/sub-index); network state uses master/slave NMT. The predefined connection set makes a node operable with default COB-IDs derived from its Node-ID.
addressing_methods: COB-ID (CAN identifier) via predefined connection set

ordering_guarantees.arbitration: CAN arbitration on the COB-ID gives a lower COB-ID higher priority; NMT control (COB-ID 0) is highest.
ordering_guarantees.pdo: PDOs are exchanged only in Operational; synchronous PDOs are ordered relative to SYNC.
ordering_guarantees.sdo: SDO is a confirmed client/server exchange.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: CANopen is not memory-mapped on a CPU bus; the device state is the Object Dictionary, addressed by a 16-bit index and 8-bit sub-index, reachable over SDO. Communication objects are addressed on the bus by COB-ID, not by a memory address.

device_classification.nmt_master: Controls NMT state of all slaves; manages the network.
device_classification.nmt_slave: CANopen device with an OD and NMT slave state machine.
device_classification.sdo_server: Exposes its object dictionary for access.
